_comment: The camera's canvas (RENDER_SEAM_DESIGN.md 4.2). skybox:none skips the sky pass entirely, and the frame graph's clear pass clears to the FOG colour - so visual/fog_color IS the background. visual/ambient_light_color #FFFFFF with no skylight is flat shadowless studio light (and it is that attribute, NOT `ambient_light`, that the 26.2 lightmap reads - see workshop.json), and no timelines means no day, no night and no moving sun. min_y -64 is load-bearing: void darkness is clamp((32 + min_y - camera_y)/32), so the working plane at y=64 sits 128 above min_y and never fades grey.
